doc: ARCH-09 function registry. One row per ESSENTIAL function: owner, inputs, outputs, contracts, runtime_process, consumers, decision_authority, failure_behaviour, verification. DATA ONLY: no row may assert a rung -- libs/ops/function_registry.py derives declared -> implemented -> connected -> running -> behaviour_verified from the tree and this host's artifacts, publishes desks/mt5/reports/FUNCTION_MAP.json (hourly leg function_registry), and scripts/check_function_registry.py (law fence) fails on a false rung. Token kinds in inputs/outputs: a filename literal the owner names, api:<def> (a function or class the owner defines), exit:status (the owner's exit code is its product). runtime_process clocks: leg:<hourly_cycle leg>, task:<box task>, fence:<law fence script>, timer:<VPS unit>; via is the declared chain from the clock's target to the owner, each hop must name the next.

functions.function: compile every seat's donated evidence into source-faithful executable candidates

decision_authority.scope: which candidates exist to be judged; no eligibility, no capital

failure_behaviour.says: an unreadable seat or frontier reads UNMEASURED and the row is carried, never silently dropped

functions.function: mine the deep CJK/RU web for verbatim trader claims mapped to MT5 analogues

decision_authority.scope: claims and mechanisms for the gauntlet; never a verdict

failure_behaviour.says: a walled or failed fetch is UNMEASURED for that ground, never an empty success

functions.function: publish scoreable beliefs (model, time, subject, kind, value, uncertainty) that own no positions

decision_authority.scope: beliefs with stated uncertainty; no lot size, no direction to act on

failure_behaviour.says: a belief missing a field is REFUSED with its defects named and never enters the register

functions.function: judge candidate cells through the sequential ten-gate gauntlet and mint certificates

decision_authority.scope: eligibility: which exact specs hold a ten-gate certificate

failure_behaviour.says: an unknown trial charge fails the deflated-Sharpe gate closed; nothing is certified on an unmeasured bar

functions.function: atomically republish the judge's certificates as the sealed canon the gateway reads

decision_authority.scope: carries the judge's verdicts forward; never re-judges and never adds a certificate

failure_behaviour.says: publishes by atomic replace; a refused or partial sweep leaves the previous canon standing

functions.function: promote certified, matured forward clocks to LIVE and retire what no longer qualifies

decision_authority.scope: LIVE / STANDBY / RETIRED per sleeve, automatically, on a certificate and a matured clock

failure_behaviour.says: a certificate key without its exact published spec is not promoted (exact policy only)

functions.function: solve the canonical robust E[log W] book over every eligible sleeve

decision_authority.scope: per-sleeve fractions and the resolved heat; controls and execution enforce and place

failure_behaviour.says: a cycle that cannot complete writes a NAMED stand-down instead of a silent stale book

functions.function: resolve the book's heat inside the fixed envelope: 20% floor, growth chooses above it

decision_authority.scope: the heat envelope; never sizes below the floor

failure_behaviour.says: only a broker or price-feed catastrophe overrides the floor; uncertainty alone never shrinks it

functions.function: open new risk only while the code running is the code that was sealed and tested

decision_authority.scope: whether the gateway may open new risk this pass

failure_behaviour.says: an unverifiable or mismatched identity refuses new risk; closes still run

functions.function: only the order path may hold order authority over the trading terminal

decision_authority.scope: which code may import MetaTrader5 or call order_send

failure_behaviour.says: any offence outside ORDER_PATH exits 1; the pending list may only shrink

functions.function: place, manage and close orders on the live account from the allocator's fractions

decision_authority.scope: orders: entry, management and exit; it decides no eligibility and no fraction

failure_behaviour.says: every refused order is recorded with its reason; a refused pass places nothing

functions.function: reconcile every forward clock: certified and enrolled, or retired with its reason

decision_authority.scope: clock status; retires orphans and uncertified enrolments, never deletes

failure_behaviour.says: a clock no engine enrols is retired with its reason recorded, never silently

functions.function: attribute every order to its fill, refusal or decline from the broker's own retcodes

failure_behaviour.says: an intent with no recorded decision price is UNMEASURED, never a zero slippage

functions.function: publish the tradable Fusion universe and its specifications

decision_authority.scope: the instrument registry; it hunts nothing and decides no eligibility

failure_behaviour.says: it refuses to overwrite a strictly better producer's row; the merge is atomic

functions.function: repair each symbol's spread from measured tape, widening only, with provenance

decision_authority.scope: cost inputs; may only widen a spread

failure_behaviour.says: a symbol with no measured tape keeps its declared spread and reads UNMEASURED

functions.function: run every research and ops leg on the core clock under per-leg budgets

decision_authority.scope: which legs run this hour and for how long; no research verdict, no capital

failure_behaviour.says: a leg past its budget is killed and recorded as a timeout; the cycle continues

functions.function: attest what actually ran on this host: clock, last run, artifact age and hash

failure_behaviour.says: an organ whose cadence is undeclared reads UNMEASURED; nothing may call it late

functions.function: census which organs have a clock, an artifact and a consumer

failure_behaviour.says: BURNING and CONTESTED may only fall; a rise exits 1 under --ratchet

functions.function: derive and publish every essential function's ladder rung

failure_behaviour.says: no output written on this host reads running UNMEASURED, never TRUE
